_partNote: Class images for the explorer tiles, rendered at about 74px. Following the rule in CLAUDE.md: one bold centered object per prompt, static or a single simple contact, no cutaways, no convergence and no internal engagement. This sheet's hard problem is that half its subjects are rectangular boxes in real life, so each class is given a different proportion and one distinguishing external feature: a wide finned transformer, an upright engine radiator block, a squat many-bladed air handler, a tall thin rack with a hose loop, a tall open cooling tower, a long low windowless shed, and a plain equipment rack.
style: Minimalist technical illustration, the style of a precise patent drawing crossed with an isometric product sketch. Uniform-weight dark slate-gray ink linework with sparse, muted steel-blue accent shading (hex 4E7AA8) on a plain very light warm-gray background (hex F2F3F1). Three-quarter isometric view, single centered subject, generous margins. No text, no labels, no callouts, no logos, no humans, no background scenery, no drop shadows. Clean, engineered, calm. Strictly two colors plus the background: dark slate-gray line and muted steel-blue fill. Every material, including wire, windings, coils and terminals, is drawn in that same palette. Absolutely no copper, brass, bronze, gold, orange, red, yellow or green anywhere, even where the real object would be that color. Favor open, airy linework with large unfilled light areas over heavy solid gray shading; the drawing should read as line art, not as a rendered solid model. Draw the subject as one whole object seen from outside. Do not draw a cutaway, a section view or an exploded assembly.

partPrompts.1: A pad-mounted electrical transformer standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a wide low rectangular steel cabinet, clearly wider than it is tall, with a panel of closely spaced vertical cooling fins covering one long side and three short insulator bushings standing up from the top deck in a row. A small hinged access door on the near end. One unit only, no wires, no fence, no other equipment.
partPrompts.2: A standby generator set standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a long rectangular enclosure on a low skid base, with a tall louvered radiator grille filling one whole end face and a straight vertical exhaust stack rising from the roof near the other end. Rows of horizontal louvers along one side. Exterior view only. One machine, no cables, no fuel tank alongside, no building.
partPrompts.3: A computer room air handler standing upright on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a tall rectangular cabinet about twice as tall as it is wide, with a large square grille of many closely spaced horizontal slats covering most of its front face and a plain flat top. Low plinth base underneath. Exterior view only. One cabinet, no ducting, no pipes, no raised floor.
partPrompts.4: A single tall narrow server rack standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: an open black frame roughly twice as tall as it is wide, filled with a stack of thin identical horizontal server chassis, and with two smooth flexible hoses looping out of the rear side and away in a gentle curve, each ending in a plain round coupling. The pair of looping hoses is the identifying feature. One rack, no other racks, no cables, no floor tiles.
partPrompts.5: A single industrial cooling tower standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a tall square open-framed structure with a large circular fan opening in the middle of its flat roof, wide horizontal louvered intake bands wrapping the lower half, and a plain basin at the base. Tall, square and open. One tower only, no piping, no roof, no adjacent buildings.
partPrompts.6: A long low windowless industrial building standing alone on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a plain rectangular shed several times longer than it is wide, with a flat roof, no windows at all, one small door at the near end, and a neat row of identical rooftop units along the ridge. Simple and blocky. One building, no cars, no fence, no trees, no landscape.
partPrompts.7: An empty equipment rack cabinet standing upright on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a plain open steel frame taller than it is wide, with regularly spaced mounting rails running down both front uprights, a perforated front door swung fully open to one side, and four small casters underneath. Completely empty inside, with the background visible through it. One cabinet, no servers, no cables, no other racks.
